comment: Which copies of the Hermes plugin scanner scripts/guard_scan.py runs. Each is fetched at the commit named here, so a CI run is reproducible; the scheduled run fetches the branch named under latest instead. The gateways run the fork; upstream is scanned as well because the fork tracks it. To move a pin, change the commit in a pull request of its own and read the scanner's report on that run. CONTRIBUTING.md says how.
